name: LiteLLM
short: Open-source (MIT) AI gateway and proxy: one OpenAI-compatible endpoint across 100+ providers, virtual keys, budgets, rate limits, spend tracking — self-hosted so your keys never leave your infra.

plans.name: Open Source
plans.notes: Self-hosted, no license fee: 100+ providers via one OpenAI API, virtual keys/users/teams, spend tracking, budgets + rate limits, fallbacks, request/response logging, Prometheus metrics.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Everything in OSS plus SSO/SCIM, OIDC/JWT auth, audit logs, secret managers + key rotation, RBAC, multi-region control plane, 24/7 support/SLAs, air-gapped deployment.
